say:2:1721426002:0.text: We have news about the prince!
say:2:1721426002:0.source_cn: 艾米！我们有王子的消息了！

say:4:1721426004:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下，我们的朋友……艾米，她就住在这里。

say:5:1721426005:0.text: Since the Hall of Ancients incident, the papers haven't stopped covering the story.
say:5:1721426005:0.source_cn: 圣古堂事件后，众多报纸都在刊登相关的新闻。
say:5:1721426005:0.male: Since the Hall of Ancients incident, the papers haven't stopped covering the story.
say:5:1721426005:0.female: Since the Hall of Ancients incident, the papers haven't stopped covering the story.

say:6:1721426006:0.text: Then some cheap tabloids started spreading rumors of the prince's death, and Amy fell for it.
say:6:1721426006:0.source_cn: 其中夹杂了许多不正规的八卦小报，传播着王子已经被暗杀的...
say:6:1721426006:0.male: Then some cheap tabloids started spreading rumors of the prince's death, and Amy fell for it.
say:6:1721426006:0.female: Then some cheap tabloids started spreading rumors of the prince's death, and Amy fell for it.

say:7:1721426007:0.text: Since then, she hasn't been herself... She's basically shut us out...
say:7:1721426007:0.source_cn: 自从王子失踪，艾米整个人都变了……不说话，也不见我们……
say:7:1721426007:0.male: Since then, she hasn't been herself... She's basically shut us out...
say:7:1721426007:0.female: Since then, she hasn't been herself... She's basically shut us out...

say:8:1721426008:0.source_cn: ……我们真的很担心，如果再找不到奥利安殿下的消息，她可...

choice_prompt:9:1721426008.source_cn: ……我们真的很担心，如果再找不到奥利安殿下的消息，她可能会做出傻事。

say:10:1721426009:0.text: If we can confirm Prince Orion is still alive… at least it would give her some hope...
say:10:1721426009:0.source_cn: 如果能确定奥利安殿下还活着，至少……至少能给她一点希望……

say:11:1721426010:0.text: But now, as you can see, she's pushing us away. We don't even know if she's okay...
say:11:1721426010:0.source_cn: 但您也看到了，她不愿见我们。隔着这堵墙，我们甚至都不知...
say:11:1721426010:0.male: But now, as you can see, she's pushing us away. We don't even know if she's okay...
say:11:1721426010:0.female: But now, as you can see, she's pushing us away. We don't even know if she's okay...

say:12:1721426011:0.text: How about we check with the neighbors? Someone might have seen her.
say:12:1721426011:0.source_cn: 不如我们去和周围的人问问吧，或许有邻居见过她？

say:13:1721426012:0.text: Sure, let's do that... I really hope to see Amy bounce back...
say:13:1721426012:0.source_cn: 好的……希望艾米的状态能好些……

choice:9:0:1.text: That's why you're so eager to find out where the prince is.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 所以你们才急着打探王子的下落
choice:9:0:1.male: That's why you're so eager to find out where the prince is.
choice:9:0:1.female: That's why you're so eager to find out where the prince is.
